rounds.title: PBE5AC_SET_MULTIQ_3_AND_BURST5000
rounds.hypothesis: Enabling iwpriv ath0 set_multiq 3 (0x1 5-subqueue osif_select_queue + ol_tx_ll 75% per-AC __QUEUE_STATE_XOFF + 0x2 deep 802.1Q VLAN/PPPoE inner-DSCP inspection UMAC-BUG-01) combined with /proc/sys/dev/uph_wifi0/timing='200 200 5000' (Down:200, Up:200, Burst:5000 sweet spot between 4000 and 6000) on top of Stage 73A Champion v6 improves loaded RTT and Triple-Play QoE while preserving full Bulk TCP goodput.
